headline: VMS TMT submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: Routine procedural filing from VMS TMT
summary: VMS TMT Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results of its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026, to the stock exchange. This is a standard compliance filing required after the conclusion of a company's AGM. For an Indian retail investor, this carries no financial impact as it is routine administrative disclosure.
why_it_matters: No financial impact from standard compliance paperwork.
